pages.title: Customer Logging Settings
pages.purpose: Provide cross-customer operational visibility into logging enablement, retention, purge timing, and deployment cloud. Also offers entry points to create a new customer record and drill into a selected customer context.
data_requirements: Cross-customer customer logging settings list including customer_id, name, industry, deployment_cloud, logging_enabled, retention_days, purge_after, updated_at.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Initial page load and manual refresh.
Create customer from modal/drawer form.

user_actions.note: No server-side filtering endpoint is defined; filtering must be local to current result set.

user_actions.action: Navigate to selected customer home page

loading_states: Initial full-page skeleton/table shimmer while customer settings load
Modal submit loading state for create customer

error_states.handling: Show access-denied empty state; do not expose cross-customer data.
Show duplicate customer_id error from CUSTOMER_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Show retry banner and preserve any cached list.

pages.title: Customer Workspace Home
pages.purpose: Act as a customer-scoped landing page with navigation cards to request lookup, searches, dashboards, analytics, admin users, insights, and POV administration. Also surfaces the current customer's logging settings using data already available from operational views only if passed via navigation state; otherwise this page remains primarily navigational because no dedicated get-customer endpoint exists.
data_requirements: Optional navigation context from customer logging settings list if user arrived from operations page

user_actions.action: Navigate to policy analytics routes when policy_id is known

loading_states: No required API-backed loading state for base page

error_states.handling: Show informational note that customer existence cannot be prevalidated here because no get-customer endpoint is defined; downstream screens will validate through their own API calls.

pages.title: Execution Request Lookup
pages.purpose: Let an authorized user retrieve a specific execution request by request ID or correlation ID, primarily for audit and troubleshooting journeys.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Lookup summary details before drilldown or as lightweight retrieval.

user_actions.action: Enter request ID or correlation ID
Open full drilldown page for found request using returned request_id or entered correlation ID

loading_states: Result card skeleton while lookup is running

error_states.handling: Show validation message for malformed customer/request identifier.
Show empty lookup result with guidance to verify request/correlation ID and customer scope.

pages.title: Execution Request Drilldown
pages.purpose: Display a complete request investigation view, including request/response payloads and ordered rule-step execution trail in one screen for auditability and troubleshooting.
data_requirements: Request or correlation ID from route
Rule step list with step metadata and snapshots

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Primary page load for combined summary and rule steps.
Optional secondary panel querying request-specific insights using request_id after drilldown loads.

user_actions.action: View request metadata, status, outcome, duration, and payloads
Expand/collapse JSON viewers for request and response payloads
Expand individual rule step details including input/output/intermediate values
Query request-specific insights once request_id is known

loading_states: Full-page loading skeleton for summary + steps
Deferred panel loading for request insights

error_states.handling: Show not-found state for execution request.
Hide optional insights panel behind explicit request_id query and show non-blocking inline error if insights fail.

pages.title: Search Execution Requests by Attribute
pages.purpose: Search execution requests using a flattened request-payload attribute path/value within a date range.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Search submission and reruns on criteria change.

error_states.handling: Map INVALID_SEARCH_CRITERIA to form-level and field-level guidance.
Show zero-results empty state with current criteria summary.

pages.title: Search Rule Steps by Rule and Variable
pages.purpose: Search rule-step executions by rule name and flattened variable/value within a date range, supporting content-based troubleshooting and analysis.
data_requirements: Search results containing request and step identifiers

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Primary search operation.

user_actions.action: Open related request drilldown from a result row

error_states.handling: Show validation and API error text.
Show empty state with option to adjust search.

pages.title: Search Execution JSON by Dynamic Path
pages.purpose: Search known nested paths directly in request/response content when flattened attribute search is insufficient.
data_requirements: search_in fixed to request_or_response per API contract

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Primary dynamic-path search.

user_actions.action: Inspect lightweight payload snippets from results

error_states.handling: Show INVALID_SEARCH_CRITERIA guidance and note that only supported paths can be queried.

pages.title: Execution Summary Dashboard
pages.purpose: Visualize daily execution volumes, outcomes, and average duration over a selected time range.
data_requirements: Daily aggregated dashboard items with day, final_outcome, count, avg_duration_ms

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load and refresh dashboard chart data.

pages.title: Segment Breakdown Dashboard
pages.purpose: Report execution outcomes grouped by a selected flattened input attribute, such as age band or other known request attribute path.
data_requirements: Aggregated items by segment_value and final_outcome

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load grouped segment analysis.

user_actions.action: Switch between stacked chart and table client-side

error_states.handling: Show validation for date range and segment attribute path.

pages.title: Policy Outcomes by Version
pages.purpose: Show outcome distributions and request totals across policy versions for a single policy over a time window.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Primary analytics load.

user_actions.action: Compare outcome mix visually across versions
Navigate to compare versions screen when version IDs are known
Navigate to rejection rules screen for a selected version

error_states.handling: Show empty state and retain filters.

pages.title: Compare Policy Versions
pages.purpose: Compare two policy versions on volume, approvals, rejections, approval rate, and average duration, with contextual rule definitions for the selected versions.
data_requirements: version_a and version_b entered or supplied via deep link state
Selected version context including embedded rule definitions

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Primary metrics comparison request.
Load embedded rule-definition context for selected versions.
Optional save of a manually-authored comparison note/insight from the compare screen.
Optional query of existing insights for a chosen policy_version_id and time window; must be run separately per single version because API does not support dual-version query in one call.

user_actions.action: View metric deltas and side-by-side version details
Inspect embedded rule definitions for each version

loading_states: Parallel loading indicators for metrics and compare-context panels

error_states.handling: Show validation that both version IDs and valid date range are required.
Show non-blocking warning if version context load fails while preserving metrics if available.
Show empty state indicating no executions in range for selected versions.

pages.title: Top Rejection Rules
pages.purpose: Identify which rules most frequently appear in rejected requests for a given policy version.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Primary chart/table load.

user_actions.action: Use results as investigative context for policy tuning discussions

pages.title: Execution Insights Query
pages.purpose: Retrieve derived execution insights either for a single request or for a policy-version time window. Supports exploratory AI/manual/aggregation-generated notes already stored in the system.
data_requirements: Either request_id OR policy_version_id + start_at + end_at
Insight result items with summary_text, structured_findings, generated_by, model_name

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Primary insight retrieval.

user_actions.action: Choose query mode: by request or by policy version + time window

error_states.handling: Show clear mode-specific validation: either request_id, or policy_version_id with start_at and end_at.
Show empty state with create-insight CTA.

pages.title: Authorized Admin Users
pages.purpose: View and manage active authorized admin users for execution-log access within a customer.

pages.title: Customer POV Administration
pages.purpose: Edit customer metadata and operational logging settings for the POV. This is not a full customer profile page; it relies on route-scoped customer_id and update behavior defined in the API contract.
data_requirements: Editable fields: name, industry, deployment_cloud, logging_enabled, retention_days
Optional initial values passed from operations list or previous workflow because no dedicated get-customer endpoint exists

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Submit changes to customer metadata/settings.

user_actions.action: Edit customer metadata and logging settings

error_states.handling: Render editable form with customer_id context but explain that current values cannot be fetched independently because no get-customer endpoint exists.

pages.title: Policy POV Administration
pages.purpose: Create or update policy metadata used by analytics and comparison workflows in the POV.

Navigate to policy analytics routes once IDs are available

data_requirements: Fields: version_label, version_number, published_at, is_active, rule_definitions[]

Update an existing policy version record.

Navigate to insights query page to retrieve it later
